entities.name: Replay protection
entities.description: Mechanism ensuring the same NAS message is not accepted twice by the receiver. For a given 5G NAS security context, a given NAS COUNT value is accepted at most once and only if message integrity verifies correctly.

entities.name: NAS message
entities.description: Non-Access Stratum message exchanged between UE and AMF.

entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function, network entity that supports replay protection for received NAS messages.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment, terminal device that supports replay protection for received NAS messages.

entities.name: NAS COUNT
entities.description: Counter value used in NAS security context to provide replay protection.

entities.name: 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Security context established between UE and network for NAS message protection.

entities.name: 5G-IA0 used
entities.description: Condition where 5G-IA0 security algorithm is applied, making replay protection not applicable.

entities.name: Message integrity verification
entities.description: Process of verifying the integrity of a NAS message, required for replay protection to accept a NAS COUNT value.

relations.description: AMF supports replay protection for received NAS messages.
UE supports replay protection for received NAS messages.
Replay protection uses NAS COUNT values to ensure messages are not accepted twice.
Replay protection operates within a specific 5G NAS security context.
Replay protection requires successful message integrity verification to accept a NAS COUNT value.
When 5G-IA0 is used, replay protection is not applicable.
